_regression.source: real map: Inashiro (scripted hamlet), as it stood on 2026-08-12 before the way rules learned to look at lanes. GM: 'Inashiro has village paths overlapping with rice paddies... I also think there's supposed to be a rule that paths don't pass through marshland, so same issue there.' Two defects in one manifest: a field spur whose tip stopped 28 px INSIDE the paddy outline (it was pulled back along the seat's outward normal, one fixed direction for the whole map, instead of the outline's local edge normal), and a connector running 1,286 px through the reed toe. Both rules existed and neither could see a lane - `fields_clear_of_road` and `roads_clear_of_marsh` built their way list from the road and the town streets only, which is the same shape as `ring_road_kept_clear`'s hand-written key list and looks exactly like a passing check.
